units.source_text: 前面，直到海边，都是十分舒缓的沙丘，重重叠叠了好几层，蜿蜒起伏。

en.t: Ahead, all the way to the seashore, gentle dunes lay in several overlapping layers, winding and undulating.

units.source_text: 再这样往前走下去，恐怕会有危险吧。

en.t: If he kept going forward like this, it would probably be dangerous.

units.source_text: 他迟疑了，回头一看，幸好瞭望哨被小沙丘挡住了，遮断了那边的视线。

en.t: He hesitated and looked back; fortunately, the lookout post was blocked by a small dune, cutting off the view from that side.

units.source_text: 他一点点慢慢抬起身子，立刻被一个只有从这个角度才能看清的窝棚吸引去了视线，

en.t: He slowly raised himself little by little, and his eyes were immediately drawn to a hut that could be seen only from this angle,

units.source_text: 那窝棚就在右面斜坡上的阴影里，横倒着几乎被埋没了。

en.t: The hut lay in the shadow on the slope to the right, toppled sideways and almost buried.

units.source_text: 下风处成了个深深的坑，像用汤匙剜了一下似的。

en.t: On the leeward side, a deep hollow had formed, as if it had been scooped out with a spoon.
